milestone: H2-v2 M2h — authoritative snapshot-reset synchronized replay
goal: Replace the invalid requirement that price_change events independently reproduce later trade-triggered ws_book snapshots with an authoritative full-snapshot reset replay model, then rebuild and validate the frozen H2-v2 synchronized research tape.

source_semantics.ws_book: Authoritative complete order-book state. Replaces the entire reconstructed state for the token.
source_semantics.rest_book: Authoritative complete order-book state. Replaces the entire reconstructed state and starts a new book generation.
source_semantics.price_change: Absolute price-level state update after the most recent authoritative full snapshot. Positive size sets/replaces the level size; size zero removes the level.
source_semantics.last_trade_price: Execution metadata only. It does not directly mutate reconstructed book state.
source_semantics.best_bid_ask: Validation/reference metadata only. It does not directly mutate full depth.

replay_rule.base: For endpoint T, choose the latest ws_book or rest_book full snapshot with capture_time <= T.
replay_rule.ws_base_continuation: Apply only same-token price_change rows on the same connection and generation with base ingest_sequence < delta ingest_sequence and delta capture_time <= T.
replay_rule.rest_base_continuation: Apply only same-token price_change rows in the same generation, captured after the REST snapshot and <= T, using at most one continuation websocket connection.
replay_rule.delta_application: size == 0 removes the level; otherwise replace that level with the reported size.
replay_rule.later_full_snapshot_rule: No replay crosses an intervening full snapshot. If a later full snapshot exists <= T it must be selected as the base instead.

important_change_from_m2b.removed_invalid_requirement: price_change replay must exactly reproduce the next ws_book full snapshot
important_change_from_m2b.reason: Polymarket documents book as a full snapshot emitted when a trade affects the book, while price_change represents order placement/cancellation updates.

size_validation.accepted_state_definition: Latest authoritative full snapshot plus causally subsequent price_change level updates through endpoint T.

frozen_prior_evidence.interpretation: Prior evidence establishes that the observed divergence is not caused by raw capture, normalization, or database persistence loss and is not generally repairable by inferred last_trade_price mutations.

outcome.PASS: All frozen replay validation requirements pass.
outcome.FAIL: One or more frozen replay validation requirements fail.
outcome.if_pass: Freeze the synchronized replay layer and proceed to the next H2-v2 strategy/calibration milestone.
outcome.if_fail: Freeze the failure. Do not alter acceptance criteria inside M2h.

prohibited: No modification of prior milestone conclusions
